data.summary:
**When:** [Opponent's Movement phase](vsdata:core-rule/movement-phase), after an enemy unit finishes a **[fall-back move](vsdata:core-rule/fall-back)**.

**Target:** A **LEGIONES DAEMONICA KHORNE** unit of yours that is **unengaged** and up to 6" from that enemy unit.

**Effect:** The unit declares a charge. As **charge targets**, it can pick only enemy units within its **maximum distance** that [Fell Back](vsdata:core-rule/fall-back) earlier in the phase.

effects.chargeTargetsLimitedTo: only enemy units within maximum distance that Fell Back earlier this phase
